profile.headline: I write code. I train BJJ. I work on cars. Only chose one as a career.
profile.summary:
I launched my professional journey after graduating from Georgia Southern University in 2014, diving into a contract-to-hire program. With over 10 years in the tech industry as a seasoned .NET developer, my focus now lies in crafting robust cloud-based microservices solutions.

My career has been a dynamic evolution, spanning from single-page applications (SPAs) to developing REST APIs. I thrive on exploring emerging technologies and leveraging them to create innovative solutions.

Let's connect to explore opportunities where I can contribute my expertise in cloud architecture and microservices development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently delivering on new microservices that allow our web and mobile applications to integrate with third party services our customers employ using .NET Core and Azure functions. Personally lead the integration with DocuSign including documentation and had a large impact on the design of our REST API when beginning our partnership with a newly acquired subsidiary.  To support these initiatives, I utilize XUnit to create integration and unit testing libraries as well as Postman collections.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I assisted in pivoting our desktop application from a monolithic architecture into a microservice based design Using .NET. Pushed for the introduction of a modern feature flag integration, replacing the more tedious SQL based approach. I also assisted our Cybersecurity team in product testing the new static code analysis tools the company acquired.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Working in a team environment to tackle software developments tasks

positions.title: Public Organizer
positions.description: Raised awareness of environmental and social issues and organized supporters.

projects.title: Task Tracker
projects.description: An android application used to keep track of the University Landscaping crew's work orders, employees, departments, and locations of departments.

projects.title: AuroraGSU Web Application
projects.description: We redesigned and updated our Aurora Game Development club's website.  This included using the Django web framework in Python for creating our databses, as well as Bootstrap for the front end design elements. I worked on both sides, both manipulating the database, as well as designing a few elements of the site.
